name: maverick-food-hub
description: Maverick Food Hub — multi-tenant food delivery platform (Next.js web + Expo rider app).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/rider-native install
scripts.ci:install: npm --prefix apps/web ci && npm --prefix apps/rider-native ci
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/rider-native run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/rider-native run lint
scripts.audit:all: npm --prefix apps/web audit && npm --prefix apps/rider-native audit
scripts.ci: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:ci
